text: Binary per-row flag from the "argument" column, using only the OP's own words (current text, including marked edits): 1 if the OP explicitly asks the community or readers for feedback, advice, input, opinions, responses, or critique (e.g. asks for advice, asks people to weigh in or share thoughts); 0 if there is no such explicit request, including when the OP only states a view or only uses the generic "change my view" framing. Ignore quoted text attributed to others. Do not use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you or resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred. Generic discussion of platform or delta rules is not an outcome announcement and may count if relevant. An empty or missing argument gives null.
